column1: # The proposed code and name of each reciter in the audio standard (v0.1). A
# recitation and a file name write a reciter by `code`; the tags of a file
# write the two names. One row is one person, listed once.
# A code is two lowercase words joined by `-`, and the rows are sorted by code.
# `english` is empty when the English name is not known yet.
# scripts/build-audio.py writes this table into the registries page
# of the audio standard in both languages, and checks it.

column3: Abdul Rahman bin Abdul Razzaq Al Badr
